name: @warpgogol/rate-fetcher-worker
description: RFC-0744: Rate Fetcher Service. Multi-tenant cron worker that fetches exchange rates from external sources and stores observations in Supabase.

scripts.deploy: site-kernel run deploy.preflight --service rate-fetcher-worker && wrangler deploy --secrets-file .env

testSignal.rationale: Worker behavior is covered through @warpgogol/pbp-rate-adapters package tests; direct worker-runtime tests are deferred until worker-runtime fixtures are added.
